description: A reusable terrain generation template. Applying one merges its generation keys into a Terrain3D recipe and stamps preset_id/preset_version; regions, edits and exclusions are authorial content and are never templated. This schema is documentation and editor tooling only: the engine's data-asset validator ignores additionalProperties, pattern, minItems, maxItems, maxLength, uniqueItems, const and exclusiveMinimum, so src/demi/runtime/terrain/TerrainPreset.cpp is what actually rejects a malformed preset.

name.description: Stable preset name, shown by `demi terrain presets`.

label.description: Short picker label. Defaults to name.

size.description: Terrain extent in world units, [x, z].

biomes.description: Keyed by biome name, so a duplicate biome is structurally impossible and iteration order is deterministic.

layers.description: Layer tree, in evaluation order. Omitted layers fall back to the canonical recipe defaults.

rules.description: Biome assignment rules. The key set is closed: id, layer, biome, priority, blend, elevation, slope, moisture, water_distance, substrate. The C++ loader rejects any other key.

layer.description: Biome layer this rule belongs to. Defaults to "biomes".

priority.description: Highest priority wins; a tie is broken by blend weight.

blend.description: Transition width in world units, applied on the interior side of an elevation band's lower edge.
